potentials.name: Epiphany Bonus
potentials.text: When entering Chaos, obtain 1 random Rare Card with an activated Epiphany.

potentials.name: Basic Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Basic Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Common Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Common Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: Elimination and Salvation cards have their damage and healing increased by +50%, and gain the effect to create 1 Futility card.

potentials.name: Unique Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Unique Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text:
+5% Damage for Kayron’s Destruction Damage.
If Kayron’s Attack is greater than 500, an additional +5% to that value.

potentials.name: Divine Epiphany Adaptation
potentials.text: Increases the chance for a Divine Epiphany to appear by 25%.

potentials.name: Unique Stat Upgrade
potentials.text: If Kayron’s Attack is greater than 600, +5% Critical Damage For every 40 Attack exceeding that value, +1% (up to an additional +10%).

manifestEgo.name: Sleeping Memory
manifestEgo.text: When using the Echoes of True Abyss card, additionally create 2 Futility cards.

manifestEgo.name: Awakening Memory
manifestEgo.text: For every 2 Futility cards used, deal 100% damage to all enemies.

manifestEgo.name: Vivid Memory
manifestEgo.text: Add Graveyard to the target range of Futility Cards Exhausted by the Rift of Nothingness Card.

manifestEgo.name: Inner Memory
manifestEgo.text:
Whenever a Futility card is used, gain 1 Paradox of Nothingness.
Paradox of Nothingness: For 1 turn(s), Kayron's attack card damage +10% (Max 3 stacks).

manifestEgo.name: Complete Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the level of [Basic Card Upgrade], [Unique Card Upgrade], and [Common Card Upgrade] in Potentials by 3.

manifestEgo.name: Liberated Memory
manifestEgo.text: Whenever a Futility card is generated, there is a 50% chance of applying one of the following to a random enemy: Vulnerable, Weaken, or Injured. Apply 1 stack.
